definitions.short: Teman , the name of two Edomites, and of the region and descendant of one of them
definitions.full: H8487. Teman II. תֵּימָן proper name ( masculine and) of a location a northern district of Edom , poetic often = Edom Amos 1:12 (|| אֱדוֺם vAmos 1:11, and בָּצְרָה ), Obadiah 9 (|| הַרעֵֿשָׂו ), Jer 49:7 , 20 ; Ezek 25:13 (all || אֱדוֺם ); Hab 3:3 (|| הַרמָּֿארָן ); probably also Josh 12:3 ; 13:4 (both D); in Gen 3:6 (P) as name of an Edomite chief, son of אֱלִיפַז and grandson of Esau 3:11 = 1Chr 1:36 ; 1:42 = 1:53 ; so תֵּו֯מָן Gen 36:15 . — See further Buhl Edomiter 30 .
